finding.direct_root_cause: The frozen r12 runner hardcodes a 63-hex-character M743 SHA256SUMS identity. The live, double-sealed M743 manifest hashes to the 64-character value with an additional b at position 40. require_regular_sha therefore calls fail before any result mkdir, VCS compile, or simv run.

missed_static_edge_analysis.defect_scope: Both audits verified the M743 package's own double seal and independently verified that the whole runner hash matched its contract/release. Neither enumerated every embedded require_regular_sha literal, required 64 hex characters, and compared each literal to the referenced file. The missing check is the cross-edge from runner literal to sealed M743 manifest, not either endpoint's own integrity.
missed_static_edge_analysis.m749_specific_gap: M749 records m743_review_double_seal_pass and runner_bash_n_pass, but its mechanical checks contain no M743 SHA256SUMS literal/value comparison and no 64-hex literal-width audit.
missed_static_edge_analysis.m753_specific_gap: The final-release hammer records runner_exact_sha_matches_release and m738_m741_m743_m744_double_seals_pass, but inherits the same omission: matching a frozen defective runner to its release proves identity, not executability of the runner's embedded SHA gates.
